items.text: Round 1 decisions (d1=A rename binary to prompt-manager, d2=A relink prd_refs to existing PRD sections, d3=B fix critical+high plus trivially adjacent medium) were merged into Section 8 (Contract Decisions) and propagated through Sections 9 (Implementation Strategy), 11 (Rollout Checklist), 12 (Risks), and 13 (Non-goals).

Validation gap fixed: a Hard Constraints section (Section 3) now declares this as a greenfield fix — no compatibility shims, no `pm` → `prompt-manager` symlink, in-place replacement of duplicated `resolveApiBase` implementations. Restated in Definition of Done and Non-goals.
Validation gap fixed: a final cleanup step `vrooli scenario restart prompt-manager` was added as Phase 4 step 16, mirrored in the Rollout/Validation Checklist and Definition of Done.

Open verification (executor-time, not blocking): confirm whether `cli/pm` is referenced by any sibling scenario before deleting it; the greenfield rule forbids a compatibility symlink, so any external caller must be updated in lockstep or filed as a follow-up.

plan_updates: Added Hard Constraints section declaring greenfield. Filled in Contract Decisions with d1/d2/d3 outcomes. Updated Implementation Strategy to reflect rename (no symlink), prd_ref relinking, and adjacent-medium rule. Added Phase 4 final cleanup step `vrooli scenario restart prompt-manager`. Extended Rollout Checklist, Risks, Non-goals, and Definition of Done to enforce greenfield + restart gate. Renumbered sections (Hard Constraints inserted as §3) bringing total to 14 sections.
